title: JNCASR Secretarial Support Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
organization: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research
summary: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) has invited applications for 1 temporary Secretarial Support post under Advt. No. MML/08. The application must be sent by email to Prof. Kaustuv Sanyal by the deadline of December 3, 2026.
qualification: A degree / PG Diploma in any discipline with relevant experience in project handling, administration or office management
selection_process: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an online interview
how_to_apply: Get the Application Template from the JNCASR website
Fill in the Template and prepare necessary documents
Scan the filled Template and documents
Email the scanned copies to sanyal@jncasr.ac.in by December 3, 2026
